fix(au): compare-and-set for RUNNING, outcome and CANCELLED writes (#28)

A worker's RUNNING could land on a CANCELLED written between its read and its
write. The three conditional writes now go through ComputationStore.write_unless
under ComputationStore.exclusive: a per-store in-process lock, plus a POSIX
record lock (lockf) for FileSystemStore, falling back to the in-process lock
where the filesystem refuses locks.
